Title: Study Session Timer header subtitle truncates daily goal target when enabled at 360dp
Navigation_Path: HomeScreen -> Study Session Timer Card -> Toggle ON
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Open HomeScreen at 360dp width (1.0x font scale). 2. Toggle study_timer_enable_switch ON so the 'প্রস্তুত' status badge appears.
Expected_Result: The daily study summary and goal ('আজকের অধ্যয়ন: ২ মি. ৫ সে. • লক্ষ্য: ৩০ মি.') should remain fully visible without truncating the goal value.
Actual_Result: Subtitle is constrained to maxLines = 1 with ellipsis and truncates to 'আজকের অধ্যয়ন: ২ মি. ৫ সে. • লক্ষ্য: ...', hiding the '৩০ মি.' target.

Title: StudySessionTimerSection clips title and subtitle with ellipsis at 1.5x font scale and 320dp width
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Render HomeScreen / StudySessionTimerSection at 360dp width with fontScale = 1.5f (or 320dp width at 1.0f). 2. Inspect the header text column.
Expected_Result: Title and subtitle should wrap to 2 lines so accessibility users can read the full Bengali labels.
Actual_Result: Both title and subtitle enforce maxLines = 1, clipping to 'পড়াশোনা সেশন টাই...' and 'বন্ধ • চালু করতে টগল ক...' at 1.5x font scale.

Title: Expanded Study Timer footer row wraps asymmetrically and disabled Reset IconButton lacks visual affordance
Navigation_Path: HomeScreen -> Study Session Timer Card -> Toggle ON
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Toggle Study Session Timer ON at 360dp width. 2. Inspect the Reset IconButton next to '► শুরু করুন' and the daily progress row below it.
Expected_Result: Reset button should have a clear outlined/tonal container and progress summary labels should align cleanly.
Actual_Result: Disabled Reset IconButton has no container and 0.4f outline alpha; below it, 'দৈনিক অধ্যয়ন অগ্রগতি (৬%)' wraps to 2 lines while the right summary stays on 1 line.

Title: ProblemSolverScreen BODMAS Step 2 renders raw ASCII * and / operators instead of × and ÷
Navigation_Path: HomeScreen -> গণিত সমস্যা সমাধানকারী -> মৌলিক পাটিগণিত (BODMAS) -> সমাধান ও ধাপ দেখুন
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Open ProblemSolverScreen on BODMAS topic. 2. Solve default expression (25 + 15) * 2 - 30 / 3. 3. Scroll to Step 2 ('২ চূড়ান্ত ফলাফল গণনা').
Expected_Result: Step 2 should display mathematical symbols '৪০ × ২ - ৩০ ÷ ৩ = ৭০' matching the Final Answer card.

Title: SimultaneousLinearSystemAndBridgeCard unconditionally renders on all 16 Solver topics with static 2-variable heading
Navigation_Path: HomeScreen -> গণিত সমস্যা সমাধানকারী -> Any Topic -> Scroll to bottom of solution
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Select BODMAS (or any non-algebra topic) on ProblemSolverScreen and solve. 2. Scroll below 'অনুরূপ অনুশীলন সমস্যা'. 3. Toggle '৩ চলক (x, y, z)' chip inside the Cramer's Rule card.
Expected_Result: Cramer's Rule card should only appear on Linear/Algebra topics, and its heading should update when 3-variable mode is selected.
Actual_Result: Card is unconditionally rendered on all 16 topics (ProblemSolverPedagogyComponents.kt line 950) and keeps 'দুই চলকবিশিষ্ট সহসমীকরণ সমাধান' heading even in 3-variable mode.

Title: HomeScreen 2-column module grid cards wrap titles inconsistently between 1 and 2 lines without aligned baselines
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Open HomeScreen in default 2-column GRID mode. 2. Compare 'সূত্র লাইব্রেরি' (1-line title) beside 'অনুশীলন ল্যাব' (2-line title) and 'গণিত সমস্যা সমাধানকারী' beside 'ভিজ্যুয়াল ম্যাথ এক্সপ্লোরার'.
Expected_Result: Paired cards in each 2-column row should align their internal titles
Viewport: and bottom status badges on consistent baselines.
Screenshot_Path: Vertically centered card columns without fixed title slots shift subtitle and badge baselines between 1-line and 2-line neighbors.

Title: Edge-to-edge bottom system navigation bar overlaps bottom content on all 26 screens where NavigationBar is hidden
Navigation_Path: HomeScreen -> ProblemSolverScreen (or VisualExplorerScreen) -> Scroll to bottom
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Navigate to ProblemSolverScreen or VisualExplorerScreen (where showBottomNav == false). 2. Inspect the bottom 48dp region behind the Android 3-button system navigation bar.
Expected_Result: WindowInsets.navigationBars should be applied when the app's bottom NavigationBar is hidden so bottom content and sticky bars are not obscured.
Actual_Result: MainActivity.kt sets contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0,0,0,0) with enableEdgeToEdge(), causing the system navigation bar to overlap bottom cards and sticky bars.

Title: Saved Solver History per-item Delete button uses Icons.Default.Refresh instead of Icons.Default.Delete
Navigation_Path: HomeScreen -> গণিত সমস্যা সমাধানকারী -> Solve -> সাম্প্রতিক সমাধান ইতিহাস -> Expand
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Solve any problem on ProblemSolverScreen. 2. Expand 'সাম্প্রতিক সমাধান ইতিহাস'. 3. Inspect delete_solver_history_${hist.id} IconButton.
Expected_Result: Delete button should display Icons.Default.Delete (trash icon) to clearly distinguish deletion from reloading.
Actual_Result: ProblemSolverScreen.kt line 834 renders Icons.Default.Refresh tinted red next to 'পুনরায় লোড', misleading users into thinking it reloads the item.

Title: Hardcoded light pastel backgrounds (0xFFDCFCE7, 0xFFECFDF5, 0xFFFFFBEB) cause severe Dark Mode contrast failures
Navigation_Path: Enable Dark Mode -> সংখ্যা পদ্ধতি -> অনুশীলন শুরু করুন -> Select wrong option
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Switch app to Dark Mode. 2. Open NumberSystemPracticePlayScreen and submit a wrong MCQ option. 3. Inspect the unselected correct option card (and pastel banners on ProblemSolver, Formulas, PracticeLab, MentalMath).
Expected_Result: All option cards and feedback banners should use dark-mode-safe container/text colors meeting >= 4.5:1 contrast.
Actual_Result: NumberSystemPracticePlayScreen.kt (lines 277, 334) renders near-white onSurface text over light green 0xFFDCFCE7 on the unselected correct option in Dark Mode (~1.15:1 contrast).

Title: PracticeTutorScreen answer OutlinedTextField label reveals the exact answer (${number * step}) to the active question
Navigation_Path: HomeScreen -> গুণের নামতা -> Select Table -> নামতা অনুশীলন টিউটর
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Open PracticeTutorScreen for any multiplication table. 2. Read the label inside tutor_answer_input OutlinedTextField.
Expected_Result: Input field label should prompt 'উত্তর লিখুন' without revealing the answer to the current multiplication step.
Actual_Result: BookmarksAndTutorScreens.kt line 353 renders 'উত্তর লিখুন (যেমন: ${number * step})', leaking the exact answer in English digits on every step.

Title: SquaresCubesScreen exposes raw image filenames (241713.jpg, 241715.jpg), uses English digits in tables, and has wrong Cube footer note
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Open SquaresCubesScreen. 2. Inspect TopAppBar subtitle, banner text, and 20 rows in Tab 0 and Tab 1. 3. Read the footer note at the bottom of Tab 1 (ঘন ও ঘনমূল).
Expected_Result: Clean Bengali titles without raw '.jpg' filenames, Bengali digits across all 20 rows, and accurate '১ থেকে ২০ পর্যন্ত' footer note.
Actual_Result: Displays 'ছবি: 241713.jpg' / '241715.jpg', English digits (1..20) in all table rows, and '১ থেকে ১০ পর্যন্ত সংখ্যার ঘন এবং ঘনমূল' footer beneath a 1..20 table.

Title: Multiple interactive buttons, chips, and palette circles use 36dp–44dp sizes below the 48dp minimum touch target
Navigation_Path: Navigate to ProblemSolverScreen, FormulaLibraryScreen, VisualExplorerScreen, QuizPlayScreen, or CustomizeScreen
Steps_To_Reproduce: 1. Inspect solver_copy_btn/solver_bookmark_btn (40dp) and fraction operators (38dp) on ProblemSolverScreen. 2. Inspect bookmark/copy buttons (40dp) on FormulaLibraryScreen, zoom/KC buttons (36-40dp) on VisualExplorerScreen, palette_q_* (38dp) on QuizPlayScreen, and color/icon pickers (40-44dp) on CustomizeScreen.
Expected_Result: All interactive controls must maintain a minimum touch target of 48dp x 48dp.
Actual_Result: Explicit Modifier.size(38.dp..44.dp) and minHeight = 36.dp reduce touch targets below 48dp across 5 screens.
